NOTE
**Still not ready — requested commit and screenshot fixes not visible**

New: One push since the feedback, but commit messages are unchanged and the PR description still has "Fixes part of: #16094" and the earlier screenshots. Missing: the commit message fixes (drop "Fixes a part of", put "Fixes: #16094" after the description in the last commit) and tightly cropped before/after screenshots.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't assign a reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! I don't see the commit messages changed yet: please remove "Fixes a part of" from them and put "Fixes: #16094" after the description in the last commit, per the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages). The screenshots also still need to be [precise before/after crops](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
